name: The Broken Construct

angles.text: As a mage, you may find the delicate magical devices tended by the Windshapers especially interesting.
As a shaman, you can see the old bond between the island’s people and the spirits of the wind in the constructs they gifted before departing.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the mechanical and magical challenges artisans face when keeping ancient enchanted constructs working without their original spirit patrons.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are local caretakers entrusted with tending the magical instruments, devices, and constructs gifted by the spirits of the wind. Since the spirits departed, they have worked to preserve the few relics that still function.

aliases: where did the constructs come from
faq.answer: The spirits of the wind gave the island’s inhabitants magical constructs, instruments, and devices. Since the spirits departed, very few of these creations still function.
faq.q: Where did the magical constructs come from?

faq.answer: Riaani Nightwind is an artisan sent to Valanaar’s western edge to inspect and repair one of the city’s few working constructs after it was damaged.
Most of the island’s constructs fell into disrepair after the spirits of the wind departed and their ancient patronage ended. Only a handful remain in working order.
faq.q: Why are most of the island's constructs broken?

faq.answer: Valanaar is home to some of the island’s last working constructs gifted by the wind spirits. One was recently damaged on the city’s western end, and Riaani Nightwind was sent to examine and repair it.
faq.q: What is Valanaar's connection to the constructs?

aliases: what do i do broken construct
faq.answer: You are asked to travel to Valanaar’s western edge, find artisan Riaani Nightwind, and help him repair the damaged construct.
faq.q: What needs to be done for The Broken Construct?

sections.body: Long ago, the spirits of the wind gave the island’s people magical instruments, devices, and animated constructs. Across generations, the Windshapers cared for these gifts. Then the spirits departed, and their patronage ended. Most creations fell into disrepair. Only a handful still work.
sections.title: Gifts of the Wind Spirits

sections.body: One of Valanaar’s last working constructs has been damaged. Its loss would further diminish the island’s dwindling heritage. Artisan Riaani Nightwind was sent to the city’s western edge to examine the machine and try to repair it. These ancient devices are fragile, and she needs aid.
sections.title: A Crisis in Valanaar

summary: In Valanaar, a damaged construct threatens one of the island’s last working relics. Riaani Nightwind has gone to the city’s western edge to examine it. The old machines carry a history reaching back to the spirits of the wind.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Broken Construct
